Paolo R: starting a 0.75% canary for redwood-ensemble-int4 on /summarize (route C). this variant mixes two quant kernels via runtime selector. please watch behavioural gates and ensemble consistency.
June K: ack. which gates are active?
Paolo R: temp gates: rollback if ensemble_disagree_rate > 0.8% abs OR semantic_cos_drop > 1.0% OR dedupe_inc > 0.9% OR p99_lat_delta > 170ms. also soft-sum allowed: (length_std_rel*0.6 + rouge_drop*0.8 + small_repeat*1.0) >= 1.0 -> rollback.
Samir V: +1 to adding an "ensemble_consistency" preflight that replays 1k samples and ensures variant outputs agree with baseline majority (>99% token-level match) on non-stochastic slices.
rollout-bot: rollout-bot: canary redwood-ensemble-int4 started at 1779993333 route=["/summarize"] size=0.75% policy=gradual
Paolo R: kicked off replay (1000 samples) and 3% shadow for 2h. will post diffs.
June K: include tokenization traces and KV-cache hit sequences in replay artifacts; ensemble selector sometimes changes cache framing.
rollout-bot: replay-job: replay-1779993333 started samples=1000 expected~6m
rollout-bot: replay-job: completed. summary: ensemble_disagree_overall=0.55%, docs-longform_slice=0.95% disagree, semantic_cos_drop_docs=1.1% abs, dedupe_inc_docs=0.4%, p99_lat_delta=140ms
Samir V: docs-longform disagree 0.95% exceeds our 0.8% hard threshold. the semantic drop also exceeds 1.0%.
Paolo R: given both signals, rolling back on route C. attaching replay diffs and ensemble selector traces to the ticket.
rollout-bot: rollout-bot: rollback executed for redwood-ensemble-int4 on /summarize at 1779993460 by @Paolo R
June K: opening RUNTIME ticket: ensemble-selector nondeterminism + quant kernel mismatch. assigning to @infra-quant and @runtime-team. follow-ups: 1) add ensemble_consistency preflight to onboarding checklist, 2) require 2k replay + token-trace capture before increasing to 5%, 3) consider tighter default ensemble_disagree threshold for doc-heavy routes.
Paolo R: agreed. i'll PR the gate config and add an automated post-replay signal that fails canary if ensemble_disagree in any critical slice >0.5%.
